name: Cercospora Leaf Spot
description: A fungal disease causing circular to angular brown spots on bitter leaf, especially during the rainy season. The spots have greyish centres with dark brown borders and can merge, causing large dead patches and premature leaf drop.
symptoms: Small circular brown spots with grey centres on leaves
Angular brown patches between leaf veins
Spots merging into large necrotic areas
Leaves drying up and falling prematurely
Defoliation starting from lower leaves upward
causes: Fungal spores spread by rain splash
Overcrowded planting with poor air circulation
Continuous bitter leaf cultivation in same area
treatments: Apply neem oil solution (5ml/L water) as organic option
prevention: Space plants adequately for air circulation
Avoid overhead watering in the evening
Mulch to prevent soil splash onto leaves
Practice crop rotation with non-host crops
